htmlSnippet: <html><head><script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Recipe","name":"Best Banana Bread","description":"This banana bread recipe creates the most delicious, moist loaf with loads of banana flavor.","author":{"@type":"Person","name":"Chef John"},"image":["https://www.allrecipes.com/thmb/banana-bread.jpg"],"prepTime":"PT15M","cookTime":"PT60M","recipeYield":"1 loaf (8 servings)","recipeIngredient":["2 cups all-purpose flour","1 teaspoon baking soda","1/4 teaspoon salt","1/2 cup butter","3/4 cup brown sugar","2 eggs, beaten","2 1/3 cups mashed overripe bananas"],"recipeInstructions":[{"@type":"HowToStep","text":"Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan."},{"@type":"HowToStep","text":"In a large bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt."},{"@type":"HowToStep","text":"In a separate bowl, cream together butter and brown sugar. Stir in eggs and mashed bananas until well blended."},{"@type":"HowToStep","text":"Stir banana mixture into flour mixture; stir just to moisten. Pour batter into prepared loaf pan."},{"@type":"HowToStep","text":"Bake in preheated oven for 60 to 65 minutes, until a toothpick inserted into center of the loaf comes out clean."}]}</script></head></html>
